title: Elasticsearch → OpenSearch: Snapshot/Restore Migration
description: Migrate Elasticsearch indices to Amazon OpenSearch Service using S3 snapshot/restore.

steps.action: Create Amazon OpenSearch domain (same engine version as source ES 7.x or 8.x), in VPC, encrypted, with access policy allowing DMS role
steps.verify: Domain status = Active; OpenSearch Dashboards URL accessible

steps.action: Register S3 snapshot repository on source ES: PUT /_snapshot/s3-backup with S3 bucket ARN and IAM role
Take snapshot of all indices: PUT /_snapshot/s3-backup/migration-snap-01?wait_for_completion=true
steps.verify: Response shows state=SUCCESS; all indices in snapshot

steps.action: Register same S3 bucket as repository on OpenSearch domain
steps.verify: GET /_cat/snapshots/s3-backup shows migration-snap-01 in SUCCESS state

steps.action: Restore snapshot to OpenSearch: POST /_snapshot/s3-backup/migration-snap-01/_restore with index rename pattern if needed
steps.verify: GET /_cat/indices shows all indices GREEN with matching doc counts
steps.rollback: DELETE all restored indices, re-restore from snapshot

steps.action: Migrate index templates and aliases; update application endpoint to OpenSearch domain
steps.verify: Application search queries return same results from OpenSearch as ES; latency within 10% of baseline
steps.rollback: Revert application endpoint to K8s ES service
